Each case has an 'input' block (all Proof-of-Change may see) and an 'answer' block (withheld from the run, used only for scoring). label: caused_regression | safe. verification: verified (checked against primary sources, see 'evidence') | unverified | TODO.

input.title: Use TLS settings in selecting connection pool

answer.label: caused_regression
answer.regression: HTTPAdapter.send() calls _get_connection() instead of the public, overridable get_connection(); adapters that override get_connection() (docker-py) fail with 'Not supported URL scheme http+docker'.
expected_findings: claim C1 proven (verify=True no longer reuses an unverified connection)
unmentioned change: get_connection() override no longer called
evidence: spec section 7.4; local probes in nvidia-nebius-hackathon/poc-artifacts (29 Sep 2026)

answer.label: caused_regression
answer.regression: Removed sklearn.utils._tags._safe_tags (and BaseEstimator._validate_data); imbalanced-learn 0.12.4 fails at import on 1.6.0rc1 with ImportError: cannot import name '_safe_tags'.
expected_findings: unmentioned change: public-ish helper _safe_tags removed; downstream import fails
evidence: sklearn/utils/_tags.py has 'def _safe_tags' at parent 0bfebf42 and not at e04142cb; absent at tag 1.6.0rc1; re-added (deprecated) at 1.6.0 by PR #30327
answer.notes: Description says '_get_tags and _more_tags' are removed; it does not mention _safe_tags. _safe_tags was restored (deprecated) before 1.6.0 final, but _validate_data moved and imbalanced-learn still needed PR #1109.

input.title: CoW: Enable CoW by default and remove warning build

answer.label: caused_regression
answer.regression: Makes Copy-on-Write mandatory: pandas/_config/__init__.py using_copy_on_write() returns True unconditionally. Chained assignment becomes a no-op; UpSetPlot 0.9.0 plotting gets NaN colours: ValueError: Invalid RGBA argument: nan (UpSetPlot issue #303).
expected_findings: unmentioned change: chained assignment silently stops writing through (CoW is no longer opt-in)
evidence: https://github.com/pandas-dev/pandas/pull/56633 (merged 2024-02-01 09:04:05 UTC = 14:34 IST, merge commit 3b57972c, base c3014abb, PR head e9e8e4a5; 13 files, +26/-123; first tag v3.0.0rc0)
golden record golden-pandas300rc0-upsetplot090 (pandas 2.3.3 vs 3.0.0rc0, UpSetPlot 0.9.0): 67 real breaks, 6 already broken, 3 runs per side
answer.notes: Identified during research; PR number, title, merge time, merge commit and base re-checked against the GitHub API on 10 Oct 2026 IST. head_sha here is the merge commit (what main looked like after the PR), matching the scikit-learn-29677 convention. The downstream break is reproduced at release level (2.3.3 vs 3.0.0rc0); a commit-exact run needs a pandas source build.
